scope: RefSeq and INPHARED extension of exploratory pilot
calibration_scope: Retrieval only; engineered/IgNAR/VHH/frameshift controls unfinished. No claim of complete broad-search sensitivity.
multiple_corpora: Raw E-values retain corpus-specific sizes. Candidate summaries also scale HMM E-values by total disjoint corpus record counts / source count; sequence E-values are retrieval statistics, not pooled significance tests. Duplicate records are searched but not counted as independent observations.
translation: BLAST standard genetic code, both strands; alternative codes and splice/frameshift rescue not implemented.
